'''Snarlvine''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|vine]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. It had formed multiple clinging clusters in a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] near the [[Kondrus Sea]] of the [[Jasserak Lowlands]].<ref name="MBS" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|felt]] that the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unarmed combat/Legends|combat]] instructor [[Phow Ji]] had killed someone. In search of Ji, she emerged from the vegetation, pushing through the clinging clusters of snarlvines, and discovered he had [[Death/Legends|killed]] seven [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="MBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Snarlvines first appeared in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', a [[2004]] [[Clone Wars multimedia project|''Clone Wars'']] novel written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]] as the first part of the ''[[MedStar Duology]]''.<ref name="MBS" />
